#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
using ii = pair<int,int>;
const int MAXN = 150;
const ll INFLL = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap;
    Edge(int t, int r, ll c) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c) {}
};

struct Dinic {
    int N, S, T;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> level, it;
    Dinic(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t) { g.resize(n); level.resize(n); it.resize(n); }
    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll c) {
        g[u].emplace_back(v, (int)g[v].size(), c);
        g[v].emplace_back(u, (int)g[u].size()-1, 0);
    }
    bool bfs() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[S] = 0; q.push(S);
        while(!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for(auto &e : g[u]) if(e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
        return level[T] != -1;
    }
    ll dfs(int u, ll f) {
        if(u == T) return f;
        for(int &i = it[u]; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge &e = g[u][i];
            if(e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                ll ret = dfs(e.to, min(f, e.cap));
                if(ret) {
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += ret;
                    return ret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    ll maxflow() {
        ll ans = 0;
        while(bfs()) {
            fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
            while(ll f = dfs(S, INFLL)) ans += f;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

int pos[MAXN][MAXN];
int tempo[MAXN][MAXN], alc[MAXN][MAXN];

vector<ii> vizinhos(int i, int j, int n) {
    vector<ii> v;
    if(i+1 < n) v.push_back({i+1,j});
    if(i-1 >= 0) v.push_back({i-1,j});
    if(j+1 < n) v.push_back({i,j+1});
    if(j-1 >= 0) v.push_back({i,j-1});
    return v;
}

void calcTempo(int i, int j, vector<string>& sc, int n, int cur) {
    if(i<0||i>=n||j<0||j>=n) return;
    if(!isdigit(sc[i][j]) && sc[i][j] != 'Z') return;
    if(tempo[i][j] != -1 && tempo[i][j] <= cur) return;
    tempo[i][j] = (tempo[i][j] == -1) ? cur : min(tempo[i][j], cur);
    calcTempo(i+1,j,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcTempo(i-1,j,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcTempo(i,j+1,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcTempo(i,j-1,sc,n,cur+1);
}

void calcAlc(int i, int j, vector<string>& sc, int n, int cur) {
    if(i<0||i>=n||j<0||j>=n) return;
    if(!isdigit(sc[i][j])) return;
    if(alc[i][j] != -1 && alc[i][j] <= cur) return;
    alc[i][j] = (alc[i][j] == -1) ? cur : min(alc[i][j], cur);
    calcAlc(i+1,j,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcAlc(i-1,j,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcAlc(i,j+1,sc,n,cur+1);
    calcAlc(i,j-1,sc,n,cur+1);
}

    int cnt = 1;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) for(int j=0;j<n;j++) pos[i][j] = cnt++;
    int zi=0, zj=0;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
        cin >> sc[i];
        for(int j=0;j<n;j++) if(sc[i][j]=='Z') { zi=i; zj=j; }
    }
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) cin >> caps[i];
    memset(tempo, -1, sizeof(tempo));
    calcTempo(zi,zj,sc,n,0);
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) for(int j=0;j<n;j++) if(tempo[i][j]==-1 && isdigit(sc[i][j])) tempo[i][j] = t;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) for(int j=0;j<n;j++) {

            memset(alc, -1, sizeof(alc));
            calcAlc(i,j,sc,n,0);

struct FlowEdge {
